  1. Show HN: Cornhole News – A Hacker News inspired site for news across the Midwest

    • News

    218 points · 100 comments · 19 Nov 2026, 15:38 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — Cornhole News is a Hacker News-style Midwest news aggregator with story voting, comments, RSS, newsletter signup, themes, and a politics visibility toggle. The live front page shows sourced regional headlines and labels political stories.

    Discussion — HN liked the stripped-back regional-news concept but focused on the politics filter: how items are classified, whether it will meet users' expectations, and what moderation entails. Other feedback covered moving story order after voting, missing comment/reply controls, open-source availability, state-level filtering, monetization, and the definition of the Midwest.
